tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i rig 'dzin bskul gyi zhal skong a mes zhabs yab sras dbon sogs kyi rnam thar nyung ngu // 'dir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams dang / de sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug de sras sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan can/ yab sras gsum gyi thugs dam bskul tshig tshigs bcad gsum 'byung ba'i rnam bshad kyi kha skong cung zad bkod na/ dang po nas/ de yang spyir sngags 'chang bla ma 'di'i grub pa brnyes pa'i rnam thar mang du mnga' yang 'dir lha ldan zhes pa'i tshig ris dang sbyar na/ sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid dgung lo nyer gsum phebs thog yar rgyab dpon po'i spyan 'dren byung ba dang / lha sa bsam yas sogs dbus phyogs kyi rten khyad par can rnam mjal bzhed bcas chibs bsgyur gyi lha sar phebs skabs/ jo bo shākya rnams gnyis/ rang byon bcu gcig zhal gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i rten khyad par can rnams la snyan dar mchod 'bul rgya chen po dang / lhag par gser zho phyed do tsam zhig gis zhal gser phul bas rten thams cad la gser khyab shin tu thugs pa byung ba na/ sku gnyer sogs rgyus can rnams nas gser de tsam gyi gzhan du jo bo rin po che kho na'i zhal gser tsam las mi khyad kyang / da lam kun la zhal gser lugs mthun 'bul rgyu byung song ba 'di sa skya bdag chen rang gi grub rtags su 'dug pas/ shin tu ngo mtshar che zhes gling ba byung 'dug pa ni/ ji skad du/ dbang bcu dag gi 'jig rten gyi/ /bya ba kun sgrub khyod phyag 'tshal/ /des na yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor gyi mthu las nang du rlung sems la dbang bsgyur brnyes pa'i stobs kyis phyi rol gyi dngos po sbyangs bsgyur spel gsum gyis zad par bcu la mnga' brnyes pa'i rtags yin 'dug pa bzhin dang sbyar na 'grig pa yongs 'dra ba des na/ lha ldan 'byung spel byung bzhin zhes pa ltar du nges pa bcas/

de lta bu'i grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang / ༈ /yang thugs sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug de nyid ni spyir grub pa brnyes pa'i rnam thar mtha' yas kyang / 'dir kha'u zhes pa'i tshig ring dang sbyar na/ sku gzhon nu'i dus skyed lhas su thugs dam bskang ba la phebs skabs/ dbu zhwa 'jog pa'i grab mdzad pa la/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rab bstan gyi dbu zhwa zhu ba mdzad par der gnang ba'i stangs ka zhig la nyi zer la 'jog par mdzad pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon sum du ston par mdzad pa na/ der yod thams cad ngo mtshar legs pa'i bstod tshig 'bul zhing sku tshe bar chad sogs su gyur dogs/ slad 'di rigs mi mdzad pa'i zhu ba mdzad 'dug pa gsan/ 'di yang nang du ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor gyi stobs las byung ba ste/ de yang lta stangs bzhi po sgrub nas ni/ /mkhas pas sems can gzhug par bya/ /zhes gsung pa'i don du nges te/ de la sogs pa'i grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ji ltar/ ༞ ༈ /de bzhin du rigs kun khyab bdag sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan can de nyid kyang spyir grub pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab mod/ 'dir gnod sbyin gang bzang zhes pa'i bskul tshig dang sbyar na/ de yang dbus phyogs chibs bsgyur rjes ma'i tshe yar lam ya 'brog thar gling brgyud/ gnod sbyin gang bzang gi nye 'dab gangs phug zer ba'i gnas der bzhugs bzhag mdzad pa'i sa der/ gzhi bdag gi sprul ba 'dra ba'i 'brog rigs mang po'i zho mar 'bul ba mang du snang zhing / sang nyin de rdza ra zer ba'i yas tsam zhig bsnams/ de nas sku rtsed gyi rnal 'byor 'dra zhig mdzad de/ 'di ngos la ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis byin pa yin gsung zhing phyag mdzub rtse bskor te mdzod 'dzin pa nam mkha' bsam grub la gnang 'dug pa/ da lta de nyid rang gi gzim chung rten gyi mchod bral la bzhugs pa 'di bzhin yin pa dang nang du sher dbang pho nya'i maṃ byung ba'i lhan skyes ye shes mnga' brnyes pa'i rtags te/

rkang ba'i rjes ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /lag pa bsgyur ba phyag rgya yin/ /zhes gsung pa'i don ltar nges par bcas rmad du 'byung ba'i rnam thar du 'dug pa sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags dang / ༞ ༈ /de rjes bdag gi rnam 'dren dam pa grub mchog puṇya ratna'i mtshan can de nyid ni spyir dngos grub brnyes pa'i mtshan rtags dang ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mang du mnga' yang lha chen zhes pa'i bskul tshig dang sbyar na/ gtsug lag khang chen 'di'i ka chen zhig la spyod cing lta bu'i khrum zhig gis skyon che bar byung ba na/ ka ba de rtsa spyod kyi las gra rtsam tshe skye bo phul du ma zad/ mkhas rlom rnams kyang 'di 'dra mi thub zer ba'i 'jigs rngam sgrogs pa na/ dam pa nyid nas ngos kyi phur bsrung dam can rnams las bskul kyi phrin sgrub byed pas tshegs med par 'grub yongs gsungs pa ltar nyes skyon med par sngar tshab rang 'grig gyur na/ sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bran bzhin 'khor zhes gsung ltar du nges pa bcas de la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ji ltar bstan pa mnyel lam ci ste ma mnyel bar mdzod la phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig spyir skabs 'dir yi dam de nyid rang gi rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i grub rtags dang sbyar na legs mod/ 'on kyang sa skya paṇḍi tas/ lha sku'i ngo bo gcig shes pas/ /gcig sgrub pa na thams cad 'grub//ces gsung pa'i lung du drangs te shing glang rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsgrub mchod skabs kyi dpal 'byor yar 'phel kyi yang yang nan gyi bskul ngor sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros rnam thar so sor nas btud de gzhi thog pho brang gi yang steng 'chi med rdo rje'i gur khang du sbyar ba yin shu bhaṃ/ bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams rin po che yin gyis so// ༈ /de rjes bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros de nyid kyi spyir grub pa brnyes pa'i rnam par thar pa bgrang ba las 'das kyang /

'dir de dag gi nang nas dbu rtse zhes pa'i bskul tshig dang sbyar nas/ dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying mar 'cham sku dregs pa zil non lcam bral ma phyag nas gnang skabs gong du 'chams sku de gnyis bzo ha cang med pa'i bkrang nge ba zhig yod pa la/ phyag nas skabs kyi ye shes pa spyan 'dren dus 'chams sku krang krang de gnyis 'jim rlon lag pas mnan pa ltar skad cig nyid la da lta'i rngams zil can byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di lta bu mdzad pa legs sogs grub pa'i rtags mtshan ji ltar bstan pa rnams mnyel lam ci ste ma mnyel par mdzod la phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ces pa 'di yang dbu mdzad drin can kun dga' rab rgyas kyi bskul ba ltar sa skya pa dbang sdud snying pos rnam bshad kha bskong du bris pa'i yi ge pa'ang rang nyid kyi bgyis pa'o// ༈ /o rgyan gnyis pa 'gro mgon dbang sdud snying pos grub pa'i mtshan ma ji ltar brnyes tshul brjod ma dgos/ rig 'dzin bskul tshig du/ chos 'khor dpal gyi bsam yas su/ /zhes sogs kyi don cung zad brjod na/ 'jam mgon de nyid dbus phyogs su/ chibs bsgyur gnang skabs bsam yas su bstan 'gro'i don du khro rgyal 'di'i gtor bzlog bsgrub par mdzad pa'i liṅga dgug gzhug grub ste/ lha dbye mdzad skabs liṅga de'i mthe bong gnyis bskyer te zhu 'bul byed pa dang / mig hrig hrig byed pa sogs gdug pa can gyi rnam shes gug pa'i rtags dngos su ston par mdzad cing rnam shes spor skabs phur rtse nas sbrang phye ma leb 'dra ba zhig 'phur song ba der yod gzhung gi sku tshab dang / de nyid kyi sras mo rje btsun bde mchog ma de nyid sogs zhabs 'brengs pa tshang ma'i mthong chos su gyur pa de dag kyang ki la ya me lce gsang ba'i rgyud las// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje phur pa'i rig 'dzin bskul gyi zhal skong /
